title: Install and tension a replacement timing belt (counter-balance leg) to 471 N
summary: Hands-on installation procedure for replacing an OptiSweep timing belt and setting counter-balance leg belt tension to the specified target (471 N) using equal tensioning of two screws and (optionally) a Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter, followed by torque/fastener steps and operator-station restart.
when_to_use: Use when replacing the OptiSweep timing belt and you must set the counter-balance leg belt tension to 471 N (acceptable range 448–494 N) before reassembly and restarting the operator station.
safety_notes: Perform the procedure with physical access to the timing belt assembly and use the specified PPE/tools (safety glasses, gloves) as applicable to the manual’s related maintenance context.
If using the sonic tension meter, note that excessive noise (e.g., forklifts beeping, conveyors running) can interfere with stable readings.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the timing belt assembly
Torque tool capable of 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs)
Fasteners/tools for M6x35, M8x25, and M6x20 screws

access_required: Physical access to the timing belt assembly
external_references: “Starting The Operator Station” referenced in the manual (page 66)

visual_references.description: Timing belt replacement figure showing timing belt assembly and pre-positioning of A-axis and counterbalance between threaded holes (context for belt access).
Idler pulley assembly figure (context for idler assembly and belt tensioning hardware).
Counterbalance weight figure (context for counterbalance carriage/hard stop behavior).
Gearbox figure (context for belt tensioning components and fastener locations).

steps.title: Place the new timing belt on the pulleys
steps.purpose: Install the replacement belt onto the pulley path before tensioning and securing.
steps.instruction: Place the new timing belt on the pulleys.
steps.expected_result: The replacement timing belt is seated on the pulleys in the intended routing path, ready for counter-balance positioning and tensioning.
steps.healthy_condition: Belt is correctly positioned on the pulleys with no obvious misrouting before tensioning.
steps.failure_condition: Belt is not seated on the pulleys or is visibly misrouted such that tensioning would be incorrect.

actions.label: Seat belt on pulleys
actions.exact_action: Place the new timing belt on the pulleys.

steps.title: Position counter-balance carriage on lower hard stop
steps.purpose: Set the counter-balance carriage to the correct resting position so the belt can be tensioned properly.
steps.instruction: Slightly lift the counter-balance carriage, remove the M6 fastener supporting it, and lower the counter-balance carriage to rest on the lower hard stop.
steps.expected_result: Counter-balance carriage is resting on the lower hard stop after the M6 fastener is removed.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriage rests on the lower hard stop (not suspended) with the supporting M6 fastener removed.
steps.failure_condition: Carriage remains lifted/suspended or does not rest on the lower hard stop after removing the M6 fastener.

actions.label: Lift, remove M6, lower to hard stop
actions.exact_action: Slightly lift the counter-balance carriage, remove the M6 fastener supporting it, and lower the counter-balance carriage to rest on the lower hard stop.

steps.title: Very lightly tighten M8x25 idler assembly screws
steps.purpose: Hold the idler pulley assembly in place while still allowing it to slide under the fasteners during tensioning.
steps.instruction: Very lightly tighten the M8x25 screws holding the idler pulley assembly in place so the assembly is not loose, but it can slide under the fasteners.
steps.expected_result: Idler pulley assembly is held snugly (not loose) but can still slide under the M8x25 fasteners during tension adjustment.
steps.healthy_condition: Assembly does not rattle/shift freely, yet tensioning can move it as tension increases.
steps.failure_condition: Assembly is too loose (moves excessively) or too tight (does not allow sliding during tensioning).

actions.label: Lightly snug idler assembly
actions.exact_action: Very lightly tighten the M8x25 screws holding the idler pulley assembly in place so the assembly is not loose, but it can slide under the fasteners.

steps.title: Insert M6x35 tension screws to firm contact
steps.purpose: Establish initial contact points for tensioning the belt via the actuator base.
steps.instruction: Insert the two M6x35 tension screws until they make firm contact with the actuator base.
steps.expected_result: Both M6x35 tension screws are inserted and each makes firm contact with the actuator base.
steps.healthy_condition: No gap between each screw tip and the actuator base at the contact point.
steps.failure_condition: One or both screws are not contacting the actuator base (insufficient insertion).

actions.label: Seat tension screws
actions.exact_action: Insert the two M6x35 tension screws until they make firm contact with the actuator base.

steps.title: Equally tighten tension screws
steps.purpose: Apply belt tension evenly by turning both tension screws the same amount/force.
steps.instruction: Equally tighten the tension screws to add tension to the belt, ensuring both screws are turned the exact same amount (same applied force).
steps.expected_result: Both tension screws have been advanced equally, producing balanced belt tension increase.
steps.healthy_condition: No visible imbalance between the two tension screw positions/advancement; tension increases evenly.
steps.failure_condition: One screw is advanced more than the other (unequal applied force), leading to uneven tension.

actions.label: Equal turns on both screws
actions.exact_action: Equally tighten the tension screws… ensuring both screws are turned the exact same amount (same applied force).

steps.title: Increase tension to 471 N (448–494 N acceptable range)
steps.purpose: Bring belt tension to the specified target before locking the idler assembly.
steps.instruction: Gradually increase tension until 471 N is reached (acceptable range 448 N to 494 N).
steps.expected_result: Measured belt tension reaches 471 N within the acceptable range of 448–494 N.
steps.healthy_condition: Tension reading is within 448–494 N and as close to 471 N as practical.
steps.failure_condition: Tension cannot be brought into the 448–494 N range.

actions.label: Adjust until target tension
actions.exact_action: Gradually increase tension until 471 N is reached (acceptable range 448 N to 494 N).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if tension cannot be brought into the 448–494 N range.

steps.title: Check tension only on the counter-balance leg
steps.purpose: Ensure the tension measurement corresponds to the correct belt segment.
steps.instruction: Check tension only on the counter-balance leg of the belt (counter-balance is not in the way and will not interfere with belt vibration).
steps.expected_result: Tension measurement is taken on the counter-balance leg only.
steps.healthy_condition: Measurement location is on the counter-balance leg and counter-balance does not interfere with belt vibration.
steps.failure_condition: Tension is checked on a different leg or counter-balance interferes with belt vibration during measurement.

actions.label: Measure correct belt leg
actions.exact_action: Check tension only on the counter-balance leg of the belt…

steps.title: Set Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter parameters (if used)
steps.purpose: Configure the sonic tension meter to the correct belt parameters for accurate readings.
steps.instruction: If using a Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter, set: Mass = 4.86 g/m, Width = 20 mm, Span = 1200 mm.
steps.expected_result: Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter is configured with Mass 4.86 g/m, Width 20 mm, Span 1200 mm.
steps.healthy_condition: Meter settings match the specified values before taking tension readings.
steps.failure_condition: Meter settings are not set to the specified values, leading to incorrect tension readings.

actions.label: Configure sonic meter
actions.exact_action: If using a Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter, set: Mass = 4.86 g/m, Width = 20 mm, Span = 1200 mm.

steps.title: Obtain three acceptable sonic readings in a row
steps.purpose: Verify stable tension measurement before locking the idler assembly.
steps.instruction: Adjust/check until three acceptable readings in a row are received. Note: excessive noise (e.g., forklifts beeping, conveyors running) can interfere with sonic meter readings.
steps.expected_result: Three consecutive sonic tension readings are acceptable.
steps.healthy_condition: Readings remain stable and acceptable across three consecutive checks.
steps.failure_condition: Three consecutive acceptable readings cannot be obtained, or readings are unstable due to excessive noise.

actions.label: Stabilize and re-check
actions.exact_action: Adjust/check until three acceptable readings in a row are received.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check if three consecutive acceptable sonic meter readings cannot be obtained.
If excessive noise prevents stable sonic readings, reduce noise sources and re-check tension.

steps.title: Torque M8x25 fasteners to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs)
steps.purpose: Lock the idler pulley assembly in place after achieving correct belt tension.
steps.instruction: Tighten the M8x25 fasteners to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs) to lock the idler assembly in place.
steps.expected_result: M8x25 fasteners are torqued to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs), locking the idler assembly.
steps.healthy_condition: Fasteners are tightened to the specified torque value using the torque tool.
steps.failure_condition: Idler assembly is not locked (e.g., fasteners not torqued to spec) or tension shifts after tightening.

actions.label: Torque idler fasteners
actions.exact_action: Tighten the M8x25 fasteners to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs) to lock the idler assembly in place.

steps.title: Raise counter-balance carriage and insert M6 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Set the counter-balance carriage to mid-travel and secure it with the specified screws before clamp reattachment.
steps.instruction: Raise the counter-balance carriage back to mid-travel and insert the M6 socket-head screws for the carriage to rest against.
steps.expected_result: Counter-balance carriage is at mid-travel and supported/resting against the inserted M6 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriage is positioned at mid-travel with screws installed as the rest support.
steps.failure_condition: Carriage is not at mid-travel or screws are not inserted to provide the rest support.

actions.label: Set mid-travel rest
actions.exact_action: Raise the counter-balance carriage back to mid-travel and insert the M6 socket-head screws for the carriage to rest against.

steps.title: Re-attach A-axis belt clamp with M6x20 screws and Loctite®
steps.purpose: Secure the A-axis belt clamp while ensuring the belt is not pinched and clamp aligns with belt teeth.
steps.instruction: Re-attach the A-axis belt clamp using the six M6x20 screws and Loctite®, ensuring the belt clamp aligns with belt teeth and does not pinch the belt (belt may need slight movement to line up).
steps.expected_result: A-axis belt clamp is reattached with six M6x20 screws using Loctite®, aligned with belt teeth, and belt is not pinched.
steps.healthy_condition: Clamp teeth alignment matches belt teeth; belt can move/seat without being pinched by the clamp.
steps.failure_condition: Belt clamp is misaligned with belt teeth or pinches the belt.

actions.label: Attach A-axis belt clamp
actions.exact_action: Re-attach the A-axis belt clamp using the six M6x20 screws and Loctite®, ensuring the belt clamp aligns with belt teeth and does not pinch the belt (belt may need slight movement to line up).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check clamp alignment if the belt appears pinched or the belt clamp does not align with belt teeth.

steps.title: Re-attach counter-balance belt clamp with M6x20 screws and Loctite®
steps.purpose: Secure the counter-balance belt clamp while ensuring alignment with belt teeth and no belt pinch.
steps.instruction: Re-attach the counter-balance belt clamp using the six M6x20 screws and Loctite®, ensuring alignment with belt teeth and no belt pinch (counter-balance may need to be lifted slightly for alignment).
steps.expected_result: Counter-balance belt clamp is reattached with six M6x20 screws using Loctite®, aligned with belt teeth, and belt is not pinched.
steps.healthy_condition: Clamp alignment matches belt teeth; belt is free of pinch points.
steps.failure_condition: Counter-balance belt clamp is misaligned or pinches the belt.

actions.label: Attach counter-balance belt clamp
actions.exact_action: Re-attach the counter-balance belt clamp using the six M6x20 screws and Loctite®, ensuring alignment with belt teeth and no belt pinch (counter-balance may need to be lifted slightly for alignment).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check clamp alignment if the belt appears pinched or the belt clamp does not align with belt teeth.

steps.title: Remove M6 socket-head screws supporting A-axis and counter-balance
steps.purpose: Remove temporary supports once clamps are installed.
steps.instruction: Remove the M6 socket-head screws supporting the A-axis and counter-balance.
steps.expected_result: The M6 socket-head screws that supported the A-axis and counter-balance are removed.
steps.healthy_condition: No remaining support screws; A-axis and counter-balance are held by the installed belt/clamps as intended.
steps.failure_condition: Support screws remain installed when they should be removed, or removal destabilizes the assembly.

actions.label: Remove support screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the M6 socket-head screws supporting the A-axis and counter-balance.

steps.title: Reinstall side panels
steps.purpose: Restore station enclosure after belt/clamp installation.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panels are back in place, covering the belt/tensioning area.
steps.failure_condition: Side panels not fully reinstalled or left open after completion.

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Return the station to service after mechanical work is complete.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (referenced as “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).
steps.expected_result: Operator station is restarted per the manual’s referenced restart procedure.
steps.healthy_condition: Station restart completes successfully (no immediate mechanical issues attributable to belt/clamp pinch or incorrect tension).
steps.failure_condition: Restart fails or immediate issues indicate belt/clamp problems (e.g., belt pinch, tension not within target).

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (referenced as “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).

success_criteria: Belt tension is set to 471 N within the acceptable range (448–494 N).
If using the Gates 508c Sonic Tension Meter: three acceptable readings are obtained in a row.
Idler assembly is locked by tightening M8x25 fasteners to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs).
Belt clamps (A-axis and counter-balance) are aligned with belt teeth and do not pinch the belt.
healthy_conditions: Tension reading is within 448–494 N and as close to 471 N as possible.
Three consecutive sonic meter readings are acceptable (when sonic meter is used).
M8x25 fasteners are torqued to 21.2 Nm (188 in-lbs).
Belt clamps align with belt teeth and belt is not pinched.
failure_conditions: Tension cannot be brought into the 448–494 N range.
Three consecutive acceptable sonic meter readings cannot be obtained.
Belt clamp alignment is incorrect or belt appears pinched.
Excessive noise prevents stable sonic readings.
escalation_guidance: If tension cannot be brought into the 448–494 N range or acceptable sonic readings cannot be obtained, stop and re-check the tensioning process (including equal screw advancement and measurement location on the counter-balance leg).
If belt clamp alignment is incorrect or the belt is pinched, stop and re-check clamp alignment before restarting the operator station.
